contracts_rationale: No API or schema is published; the mission renames docs files, records the moves in the existing ledger, and adds a docs-lint gate and an on-demand report whose interfaces are their command-line flags and tests.
friendly_name: Rename section indexes to README.md; docs staleness inventory and retired-surface gate
purpose_context: DocFX is retired (#6943), so ADR 2026-10-31-1 D-1/D-13 step 5 lets every docs/**/index.md become README.md with indexBasename narrowed to README. Links are rewritten through site/moves.yaml and every legacy URL stays covered. On the final paths, the content-refresh epic #3891 needs an audit first: a reproducible inventory of every published living page (last real content change, named code paths and commands, target reader, retired-surface references, text-drawn diagrams, Divio type) and a gate that fails when a page newly names a retired surface, with existing hits in a shrink-only burn-down list pointing at the section sub-issues.
purpose_tldr: Rename the docs section index.md pages to README.md (#6939), then generate a staleness inventory of published living pages and gate new retired-surface references (#7520)
